findingClass: a row settles NOT_YET_FILED - 'the company has not filed it', no retry, no alert - on a rung chain in which not one source ANSWERED. T-403 Class 1, found in four consecutive rounds through four different doors (SEBI failures returning null; a 503 written as not-filed; escalation-budget refusals returning 'absent'; an unsettled EXCHANGES:no_link inherited through an escalation whose every rung was skipped). Each code fix closed the door it could see; this check watches the room
failThreshold: state = NOT_YET_FILED AND doc_type is one the exchanges cannot serve (DRHP) AND the row's own last_attempt chain for that type has zero answered rungs (every non-EXCHANGES rung is skipped: or failed:). A row with no chain recorded is skipped, never guessed at
